name: blingbling小眼睛
description: Lightweight browser perception skill for structured websites: understand the current webpage through DOM structure first, instead of starting with heavy screenshot/browser automation. Best for forms, admin panels, search pages, settings pages, and other pages with clear interactive elements. 用户导入包（_user_meta.json source=userImport），配套 hub skill-7 可交互示例。
distillation_contract: Import [browser DOM perception] as a [reference] pack so it can help with [agent 需要先通过 DOM 结构理解当前网页], using [references/page-state-v1.md + scripts/observe-page.mjs], while respecting [轻量优先 / 结构化页面适用 / 重截图场景不适用].
key_rules: 先用 DOM 结构理解页面，再考虑截图/自动化
适用于表单、后台、设置页等结构化页面
_user_meta.json 是用户导入元数据，保留不动
boundaries: 不覆盖动作/板书/口播域（见对应 skill）
重交互页面仍需浏览器自动化兜底
